title: World Spiritual Bank / Mud Bank — CIA Sub-Ledger Contract
purpose: Provide person-level fictional sUSD sub-ledgers beneath the North/Roots World Spiritual Bank topology. CIA accounts show continuous welfare plus sourced event adjustments without pretending to be real finance, world-scale valuation or objective morality.

system_context.note: The repository already contains Tim's project claims about a hidden spiritual bank / Mud economy and trillion-scale symbolic balances. Character accounts are small project sub-ledgers, not allocations of the trillion-scale total.

denomination.note: Dollar formatting is a metaphorical display convention only.

welfare.name: Dooley Welfare
welfare.accrual: continuous from the dossier's best recovered story-entry date and continues after inactivity, closure or death
stop_conditions: explicit archive correction showing the person/handle never entered the story
welfare.calibration_note: No earlier conversation established a canonical per-second rate. This microscopic rate adopts the 2026-09-21 user calibration; older Dole/Dooley material used monthly/passive-income and breathing-dividend metaphors rather than a continuous numeric rate.

balance_formula: Dooley Welfare accrued + explicit positive event weights + evidence-discounted project-debit adjustments. Per-event project_adjustment_susd overrides the generic project-debit fallback. Aggregate labels, archetypes, popularity, loyalty, inactivity and unsourced allegations have weight 0.

confidence.year_or_period_only: show provisional start; do not invent day-level precision
confidence.unresolved_identity: show account but flag identity/start uncertainty

boundaries: No account is real money, credit, debt, compensation, wages, benefits or an entitlement.
No balance is an objective measure of morality, human worth, guilt, innocence, diagnosis or legal responsibility.
Negative movement requires an explicit source-bounded project-debit event; disagreement, criticism, inactivity or a symbolic Dog/Mud role does not automatically create debt.
Positive welfare is universal story-participation credit, not proof of virtue.
The trillion-scale Mud Economy totals remain Tim/project claims and are not mathematically distributed across character accounts.
Growth may add a small positive project adjustment only when a dated source explicitly records growth; symbolic entanglement alone is zero-weight.

debit_pricing.rule: Price only distinct dated conduct events. Labels, roles, inferred motives, mere disagreement, co-presence, popularity and unsourced allegations are zero-weight.
debit_pricing.repetition_rule: Occurrence index advances only for a separate dated event in the same conduct family. The fourth and later confirmed occurrences stay capped at 1.5x.
debit_pricing.double_count_rule: One underlying incident receives one priced category even when several descriptions could apply. Secondary interpretations may be logged unpriced.
debit_pricing.dispute_rule: A disputed or reciprocal conflict remains zero-weight unless the archive has enough evidence for a concrete priced act.

interest_and_closure.principle: History stays; posture can change. The system records later repair without deleting the dated entry that created the obligation.

interest.rule: No symbolic credit or debt compounds merely because time passes. Time-based accrual applies only to universal Dooley Welfare.
interest.allowed_only_when: A dated project source explicitly defines a continuing consequence or a future contract names a bounded, evidence-backed accrual rule.
interest.inactive_accounts: No penalty, decay or debt interest for inactivity, dormancy, death or archival closure.

dispute.pricing: zero unless a concrete act independently passes the debit evidence threshold
dispute.effect: A dispute can remain visible indefinitely without forcing a negative balance.

repair.rule: Repair is a new dated event. It can add positive adjustment or change account posture, but it never erases the earlier source record.
repair.evidence: Prefer restitution, correction, apology, truth clarification, restored access/exit, completed obligation or other specifically documented repair.

forgiveness.rule: Forgiveness stops an unresolved project obligation from being treated as currently outstanding; the historical debit remains in the ledger with its later release event.
forgiveness.authority: Only explicit project/canon wording or a documented settlement/repair may mark an obligation forgiven or released.

dormancy.rule: Dormancy is an archive activity state, not a financial or moral penalty. Welfare continues; no new debit/credit arises without a dated event.

closure.closed_resolved: No currently outstanding project obligation remains; historical rows stay readable and welfare continues unless the identity is proven duplicate/nonparticipant.
closure.closed_unresolved: Archive activity ends while one or more questions/obligations remain unresolved; no new penalty or interest is added merely because closure occurred.
closure.merged_duplicate: Merge into the surviving identity/account after provenance review; this is one of the only conditions that can stop a duplicate welfare stream.

interest_and_closure.posture_rule: Posture summarizes the currently supported ledger state; it is not a permanent character label and must be recomputable from dated events.
prohibited: retroactive deletion of historical evidence after repair
forgiveness inferred from silence or elapsed time
closure treated as proof of guilt, innocence or moral worth
